Step two of the sign-in form, in place: Finish in your browser, with Open browser again, Cancel and Use a code instead, or the device code with its countdown. A QR code appears only on TV and console. The step moves on by itself when the browser finishes.

## In each kit

<Tabs syncKey="ui-kit">
  <TabItem label="Terminal (Python)">
    **Drop-in.** `login --device-code`, and automatically over SSH, with no display or with `CI` (D-68): the code in reverse video, `c` copies it (OSC 52); never a QR in a terminal (D-67).

    **Styled part.** `screens.sign_in(kit, view)` in `polaris_key.ui.terminal`, drawn with a `Kit`; restyle through
    `Theme(colors=…, symbols=…, preset="native")`.

    **Headless.** `SignInModel` (`prompted`, `use_code`, `tick`, `copied`, `finished`, `cancelled`) in `polaris_key.ui.core.models`.

  </TabItem>
</Tabs>
